name: ponto-de-aula
postCreateCommand: npm ci && npx prisma generate && if [ ! -f .env ]; then cp .env.example .env; fi
postStartCommand: bash -lc 'until pg_isready -h localhost -U postgres >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done; createdb -U postgres tech_challenge_db || true; npx prisma migrate dev && npx prisma db seed || true'
